spanish: Y verá el sacerdote la carne la viva, y lo impurecerá; la carne la viva impura ella; tsaráat ella.

findings.issue: Common noun left as the transliteration tsaráat; a non-name lemma must be Spanish.
Masculine singular טָמֵא and הוּא are rendered feminine (impura, ella), agreeing with Spanish carne.

notes: Weqatal futures, the double article, the piel with a 3ms object, and the repeated living-flesh clause match the tokens.
